resources.title: SageMaker Script-Mode & Inference Contract Cheat Sheet
resources.description: A one-page reference compiling every folder and environment-variable contract this course teaches across training jobs, processing steps, real-time endpoints, and bring-your-own containers, pinned to the course's own Riverbend Meals churn project so you have something concrete to check your own scripts against.

resources.title: IAM Policy Templates for a Data Science Project
resources.description: Ready-to-adapt JSON templates for the exact identities a SageMaker project needs: the execution role's trust policy, a scoped S3 policy limited to one project's raw/processed/models prefixes, a tightly-scoped iam:PassRole statement, and the Glue and Redshift service-role trust policies this course's earlier lessons also depend on.

resources.title: Churn Project Sample Dataset
resources.description: A 40-row sample of the same customer churn schema used throughout this course (customer_id, tenure_months, monthly_spend, support_tickets, region, plan, churned) — small enough to open in a text editor, shaped exactly like the synthetic data every lesson's code was run against, for practicing the S3-to-Athena-to-training pipeline yourself.

resources.title: SageMaker Capstone Cleanup & Cost Checklist
resources.description: A deletion-order checklist and cost-discipline list compiled from the course's cost-management and capstone lessons — the exact sequence (monitor, endpoint, endpoint config, model) that prevents the single most common surprise charge on a personal AWS ML account: a forgotten real-time endpoint.
